_meta.note: Built by scripts/build_map_labels.py from Natural Earth 1:10m populated places (simple), rivers + lake centerlines and lakes (public domain, naturalearthdata.com). Clipped to the living-landscape map regions. x = lon + 180, y = 90 - lat; places rows = [name, x, y, min_zoom, capital]; z = Natural Earth min_zoom (lower = more important); river 'a' = label anchors [x, y, angle].
